policy: Analysis only. The sole allowed new file is impact-answer.json.
Native configuration, source aliases and exact dependencies are identical for every condition.
Type references and public barrel exposure are distinct from runtime effects.
Setup costs are retained separately; no external application impact is asserted.
Held-out expected facts remain private until the generic provider is frozen.
V2 grading is prospective. Original trial grades and source fixtures are unchanged.
Only constrained uncertainty states are accepted; unsupported certainty cannot be added as unchecked answer prose.
